title: Soviet Ukraine missiles enter countdown under disc
summary: Robert Hastings tells of Soviet Ukraine missiles enter countdown under disc, about 1982 at missile base, Soviet Ukraine, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one of them described an incident in Soviet Ukraine where where a huge disc-shaped object a very large object was seen hovering over this missile base in Soviet Ukraine and down in one of the launch capsules uh suddenly the missiles went into countdown mode

plain: A researcher and author, Robert Hastings, says that in 1982 a huge disc-shaped object was seen hovering over a missile base in Soviet Ukraine, and that down in one of the launch rooms the nuclear missiles suddenly went into countdown on their own. He says this came from classified Soviet UFO documents, passed on by a journalist named George Knapp and a man named Vladimir Platonoff. If true, it would mean something unknown could take control of nuclear weapons.
